newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria opens border with Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Syria opens border with Iraq.

text.p: Syria has opened its border with Iraq, closed since the beginning of the 1980s, to ease trade between the two Arab states, a senior Syrian official said on Monday.
He told Reuters an Iraqi economic team will visit Syria on June 6 to discuss with Syrian authorities ways of importing Syrian goods in line with Iraq's oil-for-food agreement with the United Nations.
"Two border points with Iraq in northeast Syria have already been opened and these would be used as a first stage by traders and businessmen of both countries," the official said.
The official said no decision was yet made on the resumption of diplomatic ties which were severed in the early 1980s after Syria sided with Iran in its 1980-1988 war with Iraq.

The decision to open the border and the visit by the Iraqi economic team to Syria follow a trip by a high-ranking Syrian economic delegation to Baghdad last month which was the first of its kind for over 16 years.
